I just can not recommend this game. And no, the "bad writing" is not the core problem. The main problem of this game is the tedious and obnoxious mission and exploration game design. Every time you have some fun or start to, the game reminds you why you hate it: non stop loading screens between missions that force you to travel around all the friccing time between 5 different planets just for 2 words of conversation, then moving on to the next. Why not just.... I dont know... CALL THEM? E-MAIL? You literally have an E-Mail in this game that sends you missions, so why is it so hard to use that to communicate back? 25% of my playtime is traveling between planets with unskippable cutscenes that take 30-60 seconds to load before you put a single foot on the damn thing.

The frustrating design around missions and exploration takes away a lot from this game and just exposes itself as filler and game time stretcher. The characters are OK at best, most of them forgettable and some downright annoying to the bone. The entire game premise is that you are the messias of all races, eventhough every race is intended to fend off for itself, yet here we are: everyone expects you to do every.single.small.task imaginable. It just feels that everyone is a kindergarden child that wants you to do everything for them, while offering nothing in exchange. Again, this just shows that like 50% of the missions have next to no value in the context of the story or common sense logic, and are just that: more filler.
